title: SmartSalesBench: A Resistance-Aware Multi-Turn Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Sales Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.12975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present SmartSalesBench, the first multi-turn conversational benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate large language model (LLM) sales agents against psychologically grounded, resistant buyer personas. Existing task-oriented dialogue benchmarks assume cooperative users and measure task completion; SmartSalesBench inverts this assumption, placing agents against personas programmed to resist and challenge across conversations of up to twenty turns. The benchmark includes five agent profiles, twelve buyer personas, fifteen smartphone products across six price tiers, and four controlled experiments with 3 iterations totaling 13,680 sessions. Both sales-agent and buyer persona generations are grounded through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We introduce nine evaluation metrics grouped into three tiers: primary outcome metrics (CR, BRS, RIR), secondary quality metrics (SMS, PFS, ETI), and exploratory metrics planned for future report

translated_title: SmartSalesBench：一个用于评估大语言模型销售代理的抗性感知多轮基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们提出了SmartSalesBench，这是首个明确设计用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）销售代理应对心理层面真实且具有抗拒性买家角色的多轮对话基准测试。现有的任务导向对话基准测试假设用户是合作的并衡量任务完成度；SmartSalesBench颠覆了这一假设，将代理置于被设定为在长达二十轮对话中不断抗拒和挑战的买家角色面前。该基准测试包含五个代理档案、十二个买家角色、横跨六个价格档位的十五款智能手机产品，以及四次包含3次迭代的对照实验，总计13,680个会话。销售代理和买家角色的生成均通过检索增强生成（RAG）进行基础支撑。我们引入了九个评估指标，分为三个层级：主要结果指标（CR、BRS、RIR）、次要质量指标（SMS、PFS、ETI）以及计划在未来报告中呈现的探索性指标。
tldr: SmartSalesBench是首个专为评估LLM销售代理应对具有心理抗拒性买家而设计的多轮对话基准测试，通过13,680个会话和三层级九项评估指标，颠覆了传统对话基准假设用户合作的评估范式。
en_tdlr: SmartSalesBench is the first multi-turn conversational benchmark designed to evaluate LLM sales agents against psychologically grounded, resistant buyer personas, featuring 13,680 sessions and nine evaluation metrics across three tiers, inverting the conventional assumption of cooperative users in dialogue benchmarks.
